question: Who won the 2025 French Open men’s singles title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carlos Alcaraz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carlos Alcaraz** clinched the **French Open (Roland Garros)** men's singles title in **2024**, marking a significant milestone in his career.
 
• In a grueling final that lasted over **four hours**, he defeated **Alexander Zverev** of Germany with a score of **6-3, 2-6, 5-7, 6-1, 6-2**.
 
• This victory made Alcaraz the **youngest man** in the **Open Era** to win a **Grand Slam** title on all three surfaces: **Hard Court** (US Open 2022), **Grass** (Wimbledon 2023), and **Clay** (French Open 2024).
 
• He became the **eighth Spanish man** to win the **Roland Garros** title, following the legacy of legends like **Rafael Nadal**, **Juan Carlos Ferrero** (his coach), and **Carlos Moya**.
